evidence.quote:
A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have.

observations.why: The aphoristic warning frames unrehearsed rollback as a non-asset, carrying urgency-as-worry through a stark declarative — high arousal, negative valence.
Cadence stated as a settled administrative fact — low arousal, positive valence of confident normalization.
Ownership self-assigned as a routine label — low arousal, settled acceptance of responsibility.

mints.name: UnrehearsedIsNonexistent
mints.title: a thing we have not rehearsed is a thing we do not actually have
mints.frame: Is the speaker converting a preparedness gap into a categorical absence — not a shortfall but a non-asset — to drive urgency?
